subject: Vendor onboarding: VAT registration vs reverse-charge for Nordic Cloud — PO & invoicing steps
messages:
From: Linda Sorensen <linda.sorensen@nordiccloud.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Lund <p.lund@nordiccloud.io>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 12:22:00 +0100
Subject: Vendor onboarding — VAT handling question and initial docs

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for starting the onboarding process for Nordic Cloud. We got the vendor onboarding link you sent earlier this morning, but before we complete everything we need a quick confirmation from your side about how Redwood prefers to handle VAT on invoices for EU customers.

Two quick questions:
1) We are registered for VAT in Sweden (VAT ID included in the attached cert). Do you require us to issue invoices with Swedish VAT shown, or do you apply the reverse-charge mechanism and require VAT-exempt invoices with the buyer VAT ID on them?
2) For the PO and invoicing address: should invoices be made out to "Redwood Inference, Inc." (US entity) or to your EU billing entity (if you have one)? Our accounting team will only process invoices differently depending on this.

Attached: nordiccloud-vat-cert.pdf (VAT registration certificate)

If helpful, I can also attach our standard supplier setup form. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you prefer.

Best,
Linda
Finance Manager, Nordic Cloud AB
+46 70 555 1234

---

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Linda Sorensen <linda.sorensen@nordiccloud.io>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — VAT handling question and initial docs

Hi Linda — thanks for the VAT cert, and for flagging this early. Short answers below plus next steps.

1) Reverse charge vs VAT on invoice: Redwood's standard for EU suppliers is to accept invoices under the reverse-charge mechanism when we (the buyer) provide an EU VAT ID on the invoice. In practice we prefer that vendors issue VAT-exempt invoices with our EU VAT ID and the note "reverse charge — Article 196" (or equivalent local reference). That lets our EU accounting team reclaim internally and avoids cross-border VAT charges.

2) Billing entity / PO address: We normally issue POs from Redwood Inference B.V. (our Netherlands billing entity) for EU contracts. Invoices from EU vendors should be addressed to:
   Redwood Inference B.V.
   Herengracht 123
   1015 BB Amsterdam
   VAT ID: NL819912345B01

If a vendor cannot use reverse-charge (some vendors insist on charging local VAT), we'll work with Finance to accept it but ask for a VAT-inclusive invoice and then handle reclaiming where possible — that requires additional paperwork and might delay payment.

Next steps:
- Please complete and return our vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (attached) with your bank details and confirm you can issue VAT-exempt invoices referencing reverse-charge.
- I'll raise a PO from Redwood Inference B.V. once we have the completed form and your invoice preference confirmed.

Looping in Marissa (Finance Ops) to confirm PO lead time and Dev (for procurement integration notes) — Marissa, can you confirm standard payment terms for new EU vendors and whether we need any additional tax docs?

Thanks,
Karthik
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 15:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — VAT handling question and initial docs

Hi Linda,

Thanks for sending your VAT cert. A couple of practical notes from Finance:
- Payment terms for EU vendor onboarding are standard net 30 unless otherwise contracted.
- We do require a completed vendor_onboarding_form + a scanned W-8/W-9 equivalent if the vendor has a US nexus — in your case (EU company without US presence) the VAT cert and the completed onboarding form suffice.
- Please note our PO template (attached) includes fields for the buyer VAT ID and a reverse-charge reference; include those on your invoice to avoid routing delays.

If you can return the onboarding form this week and confirm you will issue reverse-charge invoices addressed to Redwood Inference B.V., Karthik will generate the PO and we can proceed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Financial Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
